title: Recommender System for Travel
tagline: AI-powered travel destination recommender with a conversational chatbot interface.
description: A personalized travel recommender system that provides destination suggestions based on user preferences and a knowledge base. Users interact with a chatbot that collects their interests and constraints, then returns ranked recommendations using content-based filtering.

title: Spotify Replica
tagline: Full-featured desktop music player with playlists, user auth, and song uploads.
description: A Spotify-like desktop music application built with Java Swing. Features user authentication, song uploads, playlist creation and management, and a multi-threaded audio engine. Designed with a client-server architecture and a relational SQL backend.

title: Book Discussion Web Application
tagline: Community web platform for book lovers with REST API, forums, and user auth.
description: A web platform for book enthusiasts built on a custom REST API using the Slim PHP framework and Twig templating engine. Features include user authentication with session management, a book search interface, threaded discussion forums, and full CRUD operations backed by a relational SQL database.

title: HAL 9000 — Client-Server Music Streaming
tagline: Distributed music streaming service using sockets, threads, pipes, and semaphores.
description: A client-server system in C simulating a distributed music streaming service. Implements low-level IPC mechanisms including POSIX sockets for network communication, threads for concurrent client handling, named/unnamed pipes for inter-process messaging, POSIX message queues, and semaphores for synchronisation. Designed to replicate real-world streaming service constraints at the OS level.

title: Limited-Slip Differential Controller (STM32F429I)
tagline: Real-time embedded LSD controller with accelerometer feedback and Java visualiser.
description: An embedded system running on the STM32F429I Discovery board that measures individual wheel speeds via sensors and dynamically adjusts torque distribution using accelerometer data to simulate a limited-slip differential. A companion Java application communicates with the board over serial to provide a real-time graphical dashboard for visualising speed, torque, and differential state.

title: Z Language Compiler
tagline: Full compiler pipeline for a custom C-like language, targeting MIPS assembly.
description: A full compiler for 'Z', a custom simplified C-like language with its own unique syntax (keywords like bro, CEO, fact, swipe, throwback). Implemented entirely in Java, the pipeline covers pre-compilation (comment stripping), lexical analysis, syntax analysis (recursive-descent parser), semantic analysis with symbol table management, three-address intermediate code generation, and final MIPS assembly target code generation. Supports integers, floats, arrays, functions with recursion, conditionals, loops (for/while), switch statements, and error recovery with descriptive diagnostics.

title: CIVENHANCE — e-Service-Learning Matchmaking Platform
tagline: Full-stack matchmaking platform connecting universities and rural organisations.
description: A full-stack, API-driven web platform designed to connect universities, teachers, students, and rural organisations for e-Service-Learning initiatives. The system features role-based access control with four distinct user types, an automated matching algorithm based on Jaccard similarity metrics, an AI-powered chatbot recommender powered by the Gemini API, and a robust internationalisation schema supporting multiple languages. The frontend is built with Astro and React; the backend exposes a RESTful API built on Node.js and Express, backed by a PostgreSQL database.
